crossRefs.note: Now Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son who was lame in his feet. He was five years old when the news came about Saul and…
Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, and fell on his face, and showed respect. David…
Till the land for him, you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread…
Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard…
Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All that lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Mephibosheth
people.line: Son of Jonathan and grandson of King Saul.

people.name: Micah
people.line: Son of Mephibosheth, grandson of Jonathan.

translations.web: The son of Jonathan was Merib Baal. Merib Baal became the father of Micah.
translations.bsb: The son of Jonathan: Merib-baal, and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.
translations.kjv: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.
translations.asv: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.
